data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability. While they successfully delivered on eyewear growth and keep long-term jewellery targets on track, they dropped specific store expansion targets for Tanishq and beYon without providing updates in subsequent quarters.

lines.line: Targeted 35 to 40 new Tanishq stores in FY26; actual outcome not mentioned, status dropped.
Eyewear targeted 13% to 14% growth; actual reached 44.9% in FY26, status kept.
Jewellery targeted 15% to 20% growth; actual stands at 19.1%, status on track.
Targeted 10 to 12 beYon stores; actual outcome not mentioned, status dropped.

bull: Revenue compounded at 32.3% and net profit at 39.1% annually over five years, supported by strong five-year ROE of 37.7%.
EBITDA margin widened from 8.0% in FY21 to 9.5% in FY26, alongside an 11.2% TTM EBITDA margin.
Jewellery growth is currently on track at 19.1% against a target of 15% to 20%.
bear: Borrowings jumped to ₹27,638 cr against net worth of ₹18,263 cr, driving debt-to-equity to a heavily geared 1.51.
Operating cash flow was only 43% of reported profit over five years, with negative cash flows in FY22 and FY25.
Growth is slowing, with three-year revenue growth dropping to 29.2% annually compared to 32.3% over five years.
